featureScreens.family: hustle: contested shots, deflections, defensive loose-ball recoveries, charges drawn
featureScreens.reason: Every primary paired 95% date-block interval included zero. Charges drawn and defensive loose-ball recoveries had small favorable point estimates, but remain provisional rather than selected.

featureScreens.family: rotation continuity: active-player, starter, and minute-share overlap
featureScreens.decision: no feature retained yet; do not run a combination from this family
featureScreens.reason: Active-player and starter overlap had interval-separated harm in their tested heads. Minute-share margin overlap had a negligible favorable point estimate but its paired 95% interval crossed zero; the total-head minute-share input had no point gain. The six inputs were not exact or near duplicates of selected Candidate100 fields, so the non-selection reflects screen results rather than redundant aliases.

featureScreens.family: history reliability: current-season and prior-season support
featureScreens.screen: four isolated total-head and margin-head additions
featureScreens.decision: no feature retained; do not run a history-reliability combination
featureScreens.reason: The prior-season total-support feature had a negligible favorable raw-total-MAE point estimate (-0.00027), but its paired 95% interval crossed zero and raw total squared error worsened. The current-season margin-support feature slightly improved Brier/log loss but had interval-separated harm in home-score CRPS and interval score. The other two additions had no primary point gain. None clears the rule requiring an intended-metric benefit without clear repeated primary or distribution harm.

featureScreens.family: Candidate21 raw pace and Four Factors
featureScreens.screen: seven isolated total-head or margin-head additions against Candidate100
featureScreens.decision: no feature retained; no raw-feature combination scheduled
featureScreens.reason: All seven primary paired 95% intervals for their intended MAE include zero. Three margin additions worsen pooled margin MAE and probability point estimates. Raw offensive-rebound context in the total head has a tiny favorable MAE/RMSE point estimate but mixed season results and a clear +0.265-point signed-error increase (95% interval +0.229 to +0.297). The covariance audit found no tested C21 addition at |Pearson r| >= 0.80 against active Candidate100 features, so non-selection is based on predictive results rather than high linear redundancy.
